status: pre-registered; no stacked arm has been scored on any fold or on test

feature.source: plain fine-tune of ESM-2 3B with Škrhák et al.'s recipe (deploy/s2p_finetune_modal.py, run s2p_ft_20261006)
feature.assignment: train-fold-h rows <- fold model h (trained on the other three folds); test rows <- model `all` (trained on folds 0-3)
feature.verified: 8c: model `all` reproduces their 0.888 / 0.446 pooled (0.887 / 0.440); 8d: every held-out fold scores like unseen data
feature.table: build/residues_s2p.parquet = residues_esm64.parquet + s2p_oof, row order unchanged (sha256 1a73da3c...)

protocol.harness: deploy/s2p_stack.py: same context draw (sampling.build_context, budget 50,000, seed 0), CrypticSitePredictor defaults, tabicl 2.1.1, columns in table order
protocol.gate: control arm on train-fold-0 must equal build/cv_scores/k64_train-fold-0.json exactly before any arm runs
protocol.cv: both arms on all four train folds; nothing is selected between arms on CV
protocol.threshold: per fold, evaluate.choose_threshold at mean per-protein FPR 0.05; frozen = median of the four (the headline protocol)
protocol.test: both arms scored on test once

references_on_test.plain_alone: model `all`'s score on test (the component being stacked)
references_on_test.fixed_blend: step-7 rank rule applied to tabicl_117 and plain_alone: 0.5 * within-protein percentile rank of each

metrics: AUC and AUPRC per protein and pooled, on CB-full (231) and CB-P2RANK-apo (184); TPR/FPR/MCC/F1_weighted at the CV-frozen threshold for the stacked arms
comparisons: paired bootstrap over proteins, same resample for every arm; 10,000 resamples per-protein, 2,000 pooled, seed 0

claims.primary: s2p_117 minus plain_alone, per-protein AUPRC, CB-full: claimed as 'stacking beats the fine-tuned model it stacks' only if the paired 95 % CI is entirely above zero
claims.secondary_1: s2p_117 minus tabicl_117, per-protein AUPRC, CB-full: same criterion
claims.secondary_2: s2p_117 minus fixed_blend, per-protein AUPRC, CB-full: 'learning the combination beats a fixed one' only if the CI is entirely above zero
claims.secondary_3: s2p_117 minus s2p_53, per-protein AUPRC, CB-full: whether the 64 frozen ESM PCs still add once the score is present; reported either way
claims.reported_not_claimed: pooled AUPRC on CB-P2RANK-apo (the papers' convention); the released multitask+LIGYSIS model from step 5 as context only -- it is a stronger component built from data we do not have, so it does not test stacking

known_caveat: In CV job h, the context rows' scores come from fold models that trained on fold h. This second-order leak touches only CV, which is used only to set the threshold; no model behind any feature value ever trained on a test protein.
